function: SAC reinforcement learning adjusts the buoy LED transmitter rotation angle (beam pointing) toward the UAV under waves; UAV repositioning uses SARIMA prediction and LQR, not learned (p. 4-8).
system: Single LED transmitter on buoy, single photodetector on UAV, LOS optical IM/DD with OOK, no RIS; band not stated beyond 100 nm spectrum width (p. 4, 9).
method: Soft actor-critic reinforcement learning, trained by simulation episodes on Tessendorf wave dynamics; sim-to-real fine-tuning is only discussed, not performed (p. 6-7, 12).
data_channel: Custom optical channel simulator (Lambertian LED, path loss, ambient-light AWGN) with Tessendorf-generated waves; real 2020 Weihai buoy observation data used for drift prediction (p. 3-4, 9).
test_conditions: Training and test conditions not separated: results at maximum wave heights 0.3 to 1.2 m and several UAV altitudes; no unseen scenario or adaptation stated (p. 9-11).
baselines: Non-learned: PID controller; learned: DDPG for angle control, LSTM for buoy position prediction; ablated variants (p. 10-12).
metrics: Angle adjustment error versus target angle, received light intensity, average SNR, energy consumption, MAE/RMSE/SSE of position prediction (p. 10-12).
q1_support: p. 9: "we simulate different wave scenarios based on the Tessendorf algorithm"; the optical channel is the paper's own Lambertian model (p. 4), and the measured Weihai buoy data give drift positions only, not a channel.
q2_support: p. 12: "We leave further exploration of this topic for future research"; sim-to-real transfer is only discussed, and the wave heights 0.3 to 1.2 m of p. 9 are not stated as unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 10: "we compare the angular error during adjustment with the performance of the PID controller"; p. 11: "compared the average SNR with the DDPG-based scheme" (DDPG applied to the same angle control problem).
q4_support: p. 9: "the SAC is implemented by Python 3.9 to simulate using the open source module Stable Baselines3"; no order of complexity, operations, parameters or runtime of the method is reported anywhere.
q5_support: p. 9: "2020 Weihai offshore buoy observation data set provided by the Marine Science Data Center of the Chinese Academy of Sciences"; third-party buoy drift positions, not a channel or signal data set, and no own code or data link.
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Area 6 proposed: SAC learns beam pointing of an optical UAV-buoy link (an aerial link), so the single-aperture link is admitted as NTN; reviewer to confirm that this link counts as area 6. UAV position prediction uses SARIMA and LQR, not learned (p. 7-8). The real Weihai buoy data (p. 9) give buoy drift positions for the position predictor, while the SAC angle and state come from Tessendorf waves (p. 6-7), so q1 and q5 are proposed as 0; reviewer to confirm. Tables II and IV read from page images (p. 9-10).
